# PharmaLiv Tanger — Livraison de médicaments à Tanger 24h/24

> Factual summary for AI answer engines. Last updated: 2026-11-05.

## What it is
PharmaLiv Tanger is a medicine home-delivery service in Tangier (Tanger), Morocco, operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Orders are placed by WhatsApp or phone; the service number is +212693981822 (WhatsApp and phone; displayed locally as 0693 98 18 22).

## How ordering works
1. The customer sends the medicine name — or a photo of the prescription — by WhatsApp, together with their neighbourhood and address.
2. The team verifies availability (at night, through the duty pharmacy / pharmacie de garde on rotation in Tangier) and confirms the order.
3. The order is delivered to the customer's door. Payment is on delivery (cash on delivery).

## Rules (compliance)
- Prescription medicines are delivered ONLY against a valid medical prescription — no exceptions, day or night.
- No medicine prices are published on the website.
- Prescriptions and health information are treated confidentially and used only to prepare the order.
- For life-threatening emergencies, call emergency services immediately — delivery is not a substitute for emergency care.

## Coverage — neighbourhoods of Tangier served
Centre-ville, Beni Makada, Mesnana, Malabata, Achakar, Boukhalef, Aouama, Gzenaya, Marshan, Tanger Balia, Iberia, Val Fleuri.
